'''Prost''' was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] officer and a [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of a [[Victory II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory II''-class Star Destroyer]]. Prost's task force found itself reacting to a rapidly strengthening [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], but also a [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] [[Picket Fleet/Legends|fleet]] under [[Baruche Sloane]] exploiting the chaos to expand their influence in the [[Kalinda system/Legends|Kalinda system]] in the turbulent times after [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] death.
